fusions.name: Tidewrack Sheet
fusions.desc: Sends a page drifting into the target that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Waterlogged Ream
fusions.desc: Swings a waterlogged ream around you that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks each one 2 tiles back and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bookmarked Moment
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to mark the page: holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Blotting Calm
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, it soaks in like ink into a blotter, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you heal 5% of your maximum health per blot (30% at full). Unfed, a blot fades every 10 seconds.
